text:
maya: planning a microexperiment tied to next week's webinar — want to test 3 post-webinar nudge paths: 1) instant 100 credits + curated prompt templates, 2) staged small credits + onboarding checklist, 3) control. Need routing rules, metrics, and copy. thoughts?

jonah: love it. can we target by intent signals (watch time, questions asked)? ex: >30m or asked 2+ q => high intent.

sophia: +1. also vary CTA language: 'Try with templates' vs 'Build from scratch' — that'll test friction. keep copy short.

ben: infra question — can we do routing at the inbound layer? yes, we can. proposing a small rule snippet: 
```
# pseudo routing logic for inbound webhook
if event == "webinar_attendance" and watch_pct >= 0.5:
    cohort = "web_high_intent"
    route = "credit_template_path"
elif watch_pct >= 0.1:
    cohort = "web_low_intent"
    route = "staged_onboard_path"
else:
    cohort = "web_no_show"
    route = "control"
```
we can tag user.metadata.cohort = <cohort>.

alex: metrics to track: activation_pct (7d), avg_tokens_post_nudge, prompt_template_reuse_rate, refund/complaint rate. also funnel: email->click->redeem->first-successful-api-call. i'll add a dashboard.

growth-bot: cohort ids created: web_high_intent = whi_2026_03, web_low_intent = wli_2026_03, web_no_show = wns_2026_03 :white_check_mark:

maya: copy drafts (short):
- CTA A (templates): "Get 100 credits + prompt pack — run prompts in 1 click"
- CTA B (onboard): "Start quick onboarding — 3 steps to your first integration"
- Control: "Thanks for joining — resources"
feel free to tweak tone.

jonah: canary plan: roll to 10% of webinar attendees first, monitor 24–48h, then ramp. A/B CTAs concurrently. :thumbsup:

ben: backend effort: tag on webhook + routing + event emission -> analytics. estimate: 1 sprint to instrument, plus 1 day to QA. can do feature-flagged rollout.

maya: timeline suggestion: instrument by Tue, copy finalize Wed, launch 10% Thu, ramp next Tue. owners: infra=ben, analytics=alex, growth copy=sophia, launch ops=maya.

alex: adding dashboards and alert if redemption rate <1% or >20% (possible abuse). i'll share links when ready.

ben: deploy-bot: feature-flag created: ff/webinar_postflow_2026 with 0% default.

deploy-bot: rollout note: canary target group=whi_2026_03(10%).

sophia: also propose follow-up schedule: day0 nudge (credits), day3 tips email (templates + examples), day7 advanced templates for re-engaged. re-route if user redeems earlier.

maya: question for product: do we want templates specific to use-case (e.g., summarization, codegen)?

jonah: yes — personalize by webinar topic tags. if user asked x topic in Q&A, surface relevant templates. low lift to tag during webinar intake.

maya: ok — next steps: ben to wire routing, alex to build dash, sophia to finalize copy, jonah to add personalization tags. i'll coordinate launch ops. thanks all! :rocket:
